verdict: Yes. Skippi Ice Pops from Hyderabad pitched hygienic ice pops that don't need refrigeration during transport on Shark Tank India Season 1 and got a deal. Ice pops are cheap, loved by kids and easy to distribute when sold unfrozen.
angle: Packaged ice pops that can be frozen at home or in shops avoid cold-chain costs. Kids and families are the main buyers. Hygiene and natural ingredients set brands apart from street ice candy.
